title: Electric Field Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the electric field vector E for r > R using Gauss' law.

title: Electric Field Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the electric field vector E for r < R using Gauss' law.

title: Potential Outside
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the electric potential phi for r > R from the electric field.

title: Potential Inside
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the electric potential phi for r < R from the electric field.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention that phi approaches 0 as r approaches infinity.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for electric field and potential.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
